decisions.reason: Changing the eight approved badges from a 5-and-3 arrangement to a 4-and-4 grid does not alter which badges are approved or the existing eight-badge catalog.
The grid arrangement changes badge presentation only and does not change badge triggers, milestones, award destinations, or functions.
The badge-grid layout does not change NFT cover or product-view presentation; the same message's NFT-size approval is separate execution evidence already represented in this candidate's history.
The requested 4-by-4 badge arrangement does not alter landing-page hero content, copy, or layout.
The Mission page's descriptive mention of badges and achievement remains valid regardless of the dashboard badge-grid arrangement.
The badge-grid change is unrelated to the landing-page book cover's location, size, visibility, or control-overlap constraints.
Rearranging displayed badges does not change the NFT metadata ticket counters or other reward attributes.
The badge-grid layout has no effect on optional PDF download availability, labeling, or presentation.
The badge arrangement does not change the public next-draw sales counter or its required value.
Changing how badges are arranged in the interface does not alter whether earned badges or ticket states transfer with an NFT.
The badge-grid presentation change does not alter which successfully minted NFTs the dashboard lists.
The badge layout does not change the dashboard reward-summary data for referrals, tickets, or prizes.
